tasks.instruction: The blue tiger sits on a low wooden bench, leaning forward while tying a shoelace; one open palm rests on the knee facing the viewer, and the near foot lifts so the sole with yellow pads shows clearly.
tasks.camera: three-quarter front view, slightly low angle
tasks.visibility_requirement: One palm fully open and facing camera; one sole fully visible with all four toes and pads
tasks.intent_zh: 坐长椅上系鞋带，一手掌摊开，一只脚掌朝前

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger crouches to plant seedlings in a garden bed, one hand spreading open toward the soil with fingers splayed, and the rear foot lifted behind showing its yellow-padded sole to the camera.
tasks.visibility_requirement: Palm fully open near soil; raised sole fully visible showing four toes and pads
tasks.intent_zh: 蹲着种苗，手掌摊向泥土，后脚掌抬起露出肉垫

tasks.instruction: Balancing on a curb, the blue tiger extends one open hand forward for steadiness while the other foot lifts high behind, exposing the yellow-padded sole in a clean side composition.
tasks.visibility_requirement: Forward palm spread and clear; lifted sole fully facing camera
tasks.intent_zh: 在路缘上平衡，前伸手掌张开，后脚掌抬高展示

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger reclines on a picnic blanket reading a paperback, holding the book with one hand whose palm faces outward, while one bare foot points up so the sole and four toes are clearly shown.
tasks.visibility_requirement: Palm outward and fully visible; raised sole toward camera with all toes
tasks.intent_zh: 躺在野餐垫上看书，手掌朝外，脚掌朝上展示

tasks.instruction: Reaching up to a high shelf, the blue tiger stands on tiptoe with one open palm stretched overhead, and the other foot angled so the yellow-padded sole faces the viewer in a vertical composition.
tasks.visibility_requirement: Overhead palm fully splayed; angled sole visible with four toes and pads
tasks.intent_zh: 踮脚够高架，头顶手掌张开，另一只脚掌朝观众

tasks.instruction: Sitting cross-legged on the floor repairing a bicycle chain, the blue tiger presses one hand down flat beside the tool, palm open, while the upturned foot shows its yellow-padded sole beside the wheel.
tasks.visibility_requirement: Flat palm fully visible on floor; upturned sole clearly showing four toes
tasks.intent_zh: 盘腿修自行车链条，手掌平放地面，脚掌翘起

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger steps off a low step stool, one open palm reaching for the wall to steady balance, while the trailing foot lifts behind with its yellow-padded sole turned to the lens.
tasks.visibility_requirement: Reaching palm spread and clear; trailing sole fully facing camera
tasks.intent_zh: 从凳子上下来，手掌扶墙张开，后脚掌朝后翘起

tasks.instruction: Kneeling to pet a small dog, the blue tiger lowers one open palm toward the animal's head with fingers relaxed, and the tucked rear foot shows the yellow-padded sole facing outward.
tasks.visibility_requirement: Palm open and visible near dog; tucked sole visible with toes and pads
tasks.intent_zh: 跪着抚摸小狗，手掌张开靠近狗头，后脚掌朝外

tasks.instruction: Stretching after a nap, the blue tiger leans against a doorway, one open palm flat on the frame with fingers spread, and one foot crosses over the other so its yellow-padded sole turns to the viewer.
tasks.visibility_requirement: Flat palm on frame fully visible; crossed foot sole facing camera
tasks.intent_zh: 靠门框伸展，手掌平贴门框，交叉的脚掌露肉垫

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger sits on the floor shelling peas into a bowl, one open palm cradling a pod toward the camera, while one bare foot rests sole-up on the opposite knee showing yellow pads.
tasks.visibility_requirement: Palm cradling pod fully visible with five fingers; sole on knee clearly shown
tasks.intent_zh: 坐地剥豌豆，手掌托豆荚朝镜头，脚掌搭膝露肉垫

tasks.instruction: Climbing a short ladder to a loft, the blue tiger grips a rung with one open palm facing out, and the lower foot presses the rung so the yellow-padded sole faces the viewer.
tasks.visibility_requirement: Gripping palm turned outward and fully visible; lower sole toward camera
tasks.intent_zh: 爬短梯上阁楼，抓握的手掌朝外，低处脚掌朝观众

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger sits on a sandy beach patting a sandcastle, one open palm pressed flat on the tower top, and one foot lifted sideways with its yellow-padded sole clearly shown against the sand.
tasks.visibility_requirement: Flat palm fully visible on castle; side-lifted sole clear with four toes
tasks.intent_zh: 坐沙滩拍沙堡，手掌平压塔顶，脚掌侧抬露肉垫

tasks.instruction: Leaning to switch off a floor lamp, the blue tiger extends one open hand toward the switch with fingers spread, and one foot rests sideways on its outer edge so the yellow sole faces out.
tasks.visibility_requirement: Extended palm fully open toward switch; turned sole clearly visible
tasks.intent_zh: 弯腰关落地灯，手掌伸向开关，脚掌侧翻露肉垫

tasks.instruction: Sitting on a park bench feeding pigeons, the blue tiger holds out one open palm with crumbs, fingers relaxed and flat, while one foot tilts up on the heel showing its yellow-padded sole.
tasks.visibility_requirement: Outstretched flat palm fully visible; tilted sole facing camera with pads
tasks.intent_zh: 坐长椅喂鸽子，手掌摊平托面包屑，脚跟抬起露脚掌

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger sits on a cushion polishing a brass doorknob, one open palm cupping the knob toward the camera, and one foot raised with the yellow-padded sole pressed to the other knee.
tasks.visibility_requirement: Cupping palm fully visible with fingers; sole on knee clearly showing pads
tasks.intent_zh: 坐垫上擦门把手，手掌托把手朝镜头，脚掌搭膝

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger crouches at a stream cupping water, one open palm lifted toward the mouth with fingers slightly curled, and one foot planted sole-toward-camera in the shallow water showing yellow pads.
tasks.visibility_requirement: Cupped palm fully visible near mouth; sole toward camera clearly seen
tasks.intent_zh: 溪边蹲着捧水，手掌抬起凑嘴，脚掌朝镜头露肉垫

tasks.instruction: Folding laundry while seated on a bed, the blue tiger smooths a shirt with one open palm flat on the fabric, and one bare foot rests sole-up on the mattress edge facing the viewer.
tasks.visibility_requirement: Flat smoothing palm fully visible; upturned sole on mattress clear
tasks.intent_zh: 坐床边叠衣服，手掌平抚布料，脚掌朝上露肉垫

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger leans over a balcony railing to water plants, one open palm tilting a small can toward the pot, and one foot lifted behind so the yellow-padded sole faces the camera.
tasks.visibility_requirement: Tilting palm fully visible on can; lifted rear sole toward camera
tasks.intent_zh: 靠阳台栏杆浇花，手掌倾水壶，后脚掌翘起朝镜头

tasks.instruction: Crouched by a campfire toasting a marshmallow, the blue tiger holds the stick with one hand, palm turned outward for balance, while one foot rests on a log sole-up showing yellow pads.
tasks.visibility_requirement: Outward palm fully visible; sole-up foot on log clearly showing pads
tasks.intent_zh: 蹲篝火边烤棉花糖，手掌朝外，脚掌搭木头露肉垫

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger sits on a low wall sketching in a notebook, one open palm spread flat to steady the page, and one foot turned outward so its yellow-padded sole shows beside the wall.
tasks.visibility_requirement: Flat steadying palm fully visible on page; outward sole clearly shown
tasks.intent_zh: 坐矮墙上写生，手掌平压纸页，脚掌外翻露肉垫

tasks.instruction: Lying on the floor doing a gentle leg stretch, the blue tiger reaches one open palm toward the raised foot, and that foot turns sole-toward-camera with four toes and yellow pads clearly spread.
tasks.visibility_requirement: Reaching palm fully visible; raised sole toward camera with all toes and pads
tasks.intent_zh: 躺地做腿部拉伸，手掌伸向抬起的脚，脚掌朝镜头

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger sits in a rocking chair knitting, one open palm holding yarn toward the lens with fingers spread, and one foot propped on a stool sole-up displaying yellow pads.

tasks.intent_zh: 坐摇椅织毛线，手掌托毛线朝镜头，脚掌搭凳露肉垫

tasks.instruction: Hopping over a puddle, the blue tiger spreads one open palm for balance mid-air, and the trailing foot kicks back so the yellow-padded sole faces the viewer in a dynamic side view.

tasks.instruction: Sitting on a rug assembling a model airplane, the blue tiger presses one open palm flat on the wing, and one foot turned up shows its yellow-padded sole near the scattered parts.
tasks.visibility_requirement: Flat palm on wing fully visible; turned-up sole clear with four toes
tasks.intent_zh: 坐地毯拼模型飞机，手掌平压机翼，脚掌翻上露肉垫

tasks.instruction: Crouching to examine a mushroom, the blue tiger points one open palm toward the cap with fingers splayed, and the near foot rests on its side so the yellow sole faces the camera.
tasks.visibility_requirement: Splayed palm fully visible near mushroom; side-turned sole clear
tasks.intent_zh: 蹲下看蘑菇，手掌张开指向菌盖，脚掌侧翻露肉垫

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger leans back in a folding chair to watch clouds, one open palm raised shading the brow with fingers spread, and one foot crossed over the knee showing its yellow-padded sole.
tasks.visibility_requirement: Shading palm fully spread; crossed sole facing camera clearly showing pads
tasks.intent_zh: 躺折叠椅看云，手掌挡额张开，脚掌搭膝露肉垫

tasks.instruction: Sitting on a dock dangling a fishing line, the blue tiger presses one open palm flat on the plank beside the rod, and one foot swings up showing the yellow-padded sole to the viewer.
tasks.visibility_requirement: Flat palm on plank fully visible; swinging sole toward camera with toes
tasks.intent_zh: 坐码头钓鱼，手掌平按木板，脚掌荡起露肉垫朝观众

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger crouches to unlock a door, one open palm pressed flat against the door with fingers spread, and one bare foot lifted behind so its yellow-padded sole shows clearly.
tasks.visibility_requirement: Flat palm pressed on door fully visible; lifted rear sole toward camera
tasks.intent_zh: 蹲着开门锁，手掌平压门上，后脚掌抬起朝镜头

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger sits on a stump scaling a fish, one open palm holding the fish toward the lens with fingers spread, and one foot raised sole-up on the stump showing yellow pads.
tasks.visibility_requirement: Fish-holding palm fully visible; sole-up foot on stump clearly showing pads
tasks.intent_zh: 坐树桩刮鱼鳞，手掌托鱼朝镜头，脚掌搭桩露肉垫

tasks.instruction: Kneeling to polish a low table, the blue tiger spreads one open palm flat on the cloth with fingers splayed, and one foot lifted behind reveals the yellow-padded sole to the camera.
tasks.visibility_requirement: Flat splayed palm on cloth fully visible; lifted rear sole toward camera
tasks.intent_zh: 跪着擦矮桌，手掌张开平压抹布，后脚掌翘起露肉垫
